fix: With Euclidean open, TRIG, SRC, FLTR, AMP and LFO, and FUNC + TRIG/FLTR/AMP/LFO (Quantize, Delay, Reverb, Compressor), now close Euclidean and pass the same press to the parameter page underneath, as from any native page. Before, only NO left the page; FUNC + FLTR/LFO changed the header underneath while the Euclidean controls stayed on screen. FUNC + SRC has no native action and keeps Euclidean open. Holding FUNC + AMP from Euclidean closes and reopens it.

emulator.scope: Emulator only; not hardware evidence. Core 2.1 native builds of the same source, OS 1.53 (stock SHA-256 9bdd44bb…) and 1.54 (f78ba80f…).

pageKeys.method: On a MIDI and an audio track, each of the ten combinations (five page keys, alone and with FUNC) is applied natively from the Reverb page as a reference; Euclidean is then opened with a long FUNC + AMP, the combination pressed, and the modal must close and the LCD below the header must match the reference. FUNC + SRC must keep Euclidean open; holding FUNC + AMP must reopen it; NO must still close it.

regressions.note: Same pass counts as 1.1.4 on both OSes.

emulator.coldBoot: Both all-mods SysEx files cold-boot to a settled UI.

coverage: Page keys and FUNC shortcuts leave Euclidean; holding FUNC + AMP reopens it
hardware.configurations: All six mods together, and Euclidean alone, on each OS.
hardware.result: Working as intended; no failures reported.
limitations: Individual outcomes were not itemized beyond the coverage listed.
Firmware was not read back from the device; build hashes identify the files provided for testing.
